page_title: GET 0-0 CEL | Getafe v Celta Vigo 01/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) gets inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but smashes his shot just inches past the left post. He should have scored!
90+3' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Today's match ends for Luis Vazquez who will be replaced by Allan Nyom (Getafe).
90' Jose Bordalas Jimenez is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Kiko Femenia (Getafe) suffers an injury and Alex Sancris comes on.
90' Domingos Duarte (Getafe) is being substituted because of an injury. Jose Bordalas Jimenez sends Sebastian Boselli on the pitch.
88' The game is interrupted now, Kiko Femenia (Getafe) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
86' Referee Iosu Galech sees the trip by Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.

84' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Getafe.
83' Luis Vazquez (Getafe) pounces on a cross into the middle of the box, but plants his header well wide of the right post.
81' It's time for a substitution. Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) comes on in place of Fernando Lopez.
77' That's the end of the game for Martin Satriano, who is replaced by Adrian Liso (Getafe).
77' Claudio Giraldez has decided to make a change. Javier Rueda (Celta Vigo) replaces Jones El Abdellaoui.
76' It is time for a substitution. Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) is on for Borja Iglesias.
74' The resulting set piece from Celta Vigo is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
73' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but David Soria makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
71' The resulting corner from Miguel Roman (Celta Vigo) comes to nothing.
68' Here comes a substitution. Javier Munoz (Getafe) is brought on as a substitute for Mario Martin.
68' Here is a change. Williot Swedberg is going off and Claudio Giraldez gives the last tactical orders to Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo).
68' Substitution. Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Oscar Mingueza walks off.
66' The opposition can't get near Martin Satriano (Getafe), who finally takes a shot inside the box. The effort looks goalbound but veers just wide of the left post at the last second.
64' Mario Martin (Getafe) timed his run perfectly to connect with the resulting corner kick, but his finish from around the penalty spot was rather poor as it went way over the bar.
64' Luis Milla (Getafe) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
61' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) has tested the patience of referee Iosu Galech and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
60' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) sends a chip pass into the box, but David Soria is quickest to intercept the ball.
58' Miguel Roman (Celta Vigo) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
58' The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 13:9.
54' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Iosu Galech saw the whole situation.
50' The flag goes up and the referee blows his whistle - another offside by Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo), who has already been caught several times today.
50' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
48' A cross is slung in towards the penalty spot and Luis Vazquez (Getafe) creates space for himself but sends his header inches over the bar.

47' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.

44' That didn't go as planned! Luis Vazquez (Getafe) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Ionut Radu, who easily kept it out.
44' Zaid Romero (Getafe) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
42' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) heads on.

41' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Iosu Galech with no other option than to blow for a foul.
40' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) is flagged offside and it's not the first time today.
39' Martin Satriano (Getafe) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Ionut Radu, who smothers the ball.
35' Martin Satriano (Getafe) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Iosu Galech had an easy-decision to make.
33' Luis Vazquez (Getafe) bangs in a header at goal from near the penalty spot after a decent cross, but it lacks power and accuracy and spins well past the left post.
30' Zaid Romero (Getafe) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
28' Luis Milla (Getafe) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
27' Getafe get a corner.
25' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but it is straight at David Soria.
24' Poor challenge! Kiko Femenia (Getafe) is penalised for tripping and Iosu Galech blows his whistle. A free kick to Celta Vigo.
23' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
21' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Getafe comes to nothing.
20' A poorly taken free kick by Luis Milla (Getafe)! He sends a shot from the edge of the box into the defensive wall. Getafe force their opponents to concede a corner.
19' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) was quite harsh and Iosu Galech didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
17' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 1:0.
12' A pass from Jones El Abdellaoui (Celta Vigo) is intercepted by David Soria and the move breaks down.
10' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) is able to continue to play.
8' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
8' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) timed his run perfectly to connect with the resulting corner kick, but his finish from around the penalty spot was rather poor as it went well wide of the left post.
7' Corner kick. Luis Milla (Getafe) is ready to send the ball into the box.
6' Flag up against Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
3' Luis Milla (Getafe) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Getafe will kick the game off.
Iosu Galech will officiate today.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
